method: Two passes, same method. Each row was matched against a freshly fetched governing-body page or endpoint. Participants, date, venue and (where the publisher states one) start time and game identifier were compared value by value. The T21 pass re-opened every page it could reach after the T20 pass and supersedes T20's verdict where it found something new; each row prints the pass that read it. A row is marked confirmed only when the official page was actually read in this pass, corrected only when the page settles the value unambiguously, and flagged when the page disagrees or cannot decide it.

findings.area: Snooker — session clock is rendered in the viewer's timezone
findings.detail: WST publishes no UTC session time. The fetch client renders publisher clocks at UTC-4 (all five RLWC kick-offs mapped exactly under that offset), which puts WST's 05:00/08:00/09:00/14:00/15:00 displays at roughly 09:00/12:00/13:00/18:00/19:00 UTC. That derivation is arithmetic on a rendering, not a published value.
findings.status: start_utc stays blank for all eleven rows; the flag now explains the rendering instead of asserting a local session time.

findings.area: AFLW — the ladder used to price nine rows is not the official 2026 ladder
findings.detail: Every AFLW row cites a 2026 R10 ladder input. Read against the official afl.com.au 2026 AFLW ladder after Round 10, the published inputs do not reconcile: the rows give North Melbourne 40 points (10-0) where the official table has 36 (9-1), Geelong 16 points at 13th where the official table has 36 at 2nd, Gold Coast 4 points at 18th where the official table has 28 at 5th, St Kilda 20 points at 10th where the official table has 4 at 18th, and so on for 16 of the 18 clubs. The fixture facts were verified in this pass and nine start times plus one venue were corrected; the pricing inputs were not.
findings.status: Disclosed, not silently re-priced. Re-pricing would rewrite nine published rows and the three AFLW high-confidence picks in the same commit that discovered the error, which is how a desk loses its audit trail. Every AFLW row now carries the mismatch as a flag, the official ladder link is on this register, and T22 in COORDINATION.md is the dedicated re-price task.

findings.area: Top 14 — the Sunday fixture is after the French DST change
findings.detail: La Rochelle v Bordeaux-Bègles is listed at 21h05 on Sunday 25 October. France leaves CEST at 03:00 that morning, so 21h05 is CET and equals 20:05Z. A naive CEST conversion would have produced 19:05Z and looked like a one-hour error in the row; the row is right.
findings.status: Confirmed, no change. Recorded because the same trap applies to every other Sunday European fixture after 25 October.
